v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, * qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus.
text.en: Behold an high priest, * who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous.

text.la: Non est invéntus * símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi.
text.en: None was found like unto him, * to keep the Law of the Most High.

text.la: Ideo iureiurándo * fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
text.en: Therefore the Lord assured him * by an oath that He would multiply his seed among His people.

text.la: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo.
text.en: O all ye Priests of God, * bless ye the Lord O all ye servants of the Lord, sing praises unto our God.

text.la: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Good and faithful servant, * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.en: Let them exalt Him in the congregation of the people.

r.la: Et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.
r.en: And praise Him in the assembly of the elders.

text.la: Quodcúmque * ligáveris super terram, erit ligátum et in cælis; et quodcúmque sólveris super terram, erit solútum et in cælis: dicit Dóminus Simóni Petro.
text.en: Thus saith the Lord * unto Simon Peter: Whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth, shall be bound in heaven; and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth, shall be loosed in heaven.

text.la: Deus, qui beáto Petro Apóstolo tuo, collátis clávibus regni cæléstis, ligándi atque solvéndi pontifícium tradidísti: concéde; ut, intercessiónis eius auxílio, a peccatórum nostrórum néxibus liberémur:
text.en: O God, Who hast given unto thy Blessed Apostle Peter the keys of the kingdom of heaven, and the power to bind and to loose, loose us, we beseech thee, at his mighty intercession, from all the bands of our sins.

title.la: Feria Secunda infra Hebdomadam II in Quadragesima
title.en: Feria Secunda infra Hebdomadam II in Quadragesima

text.la: Ego princípium, qui et loquor vobis.
text.en: The beginning, who also speak unto you.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut família tua, quæ se, affligéndo carnem, ab aliméntis ábstinet, sectándo iustítiam, a culpa ieiúnet.
text.en: Almighty God, grant, we beseech thee, unto this thy family, that as they do abstain from meals to afflict the flesh, so by following after righteousness they may fast from sin.
